name: [🎄SALE] Mow Ur Snow! ❄️
desc:
✨ Welcome to Mow Ur Snow! ✨

A satisfying incremental game where you slice through snow and grow stronger every minute

• ❄️ Mow your plot to earn snow
• 💫 Collect Snowbux for special upgrades and insane boosts
• 📈 Expand your plot and watch it grow HUGE
• 🔄 Rebirth to unlock powerful new mowers and become a snow-shredding master
• 🐾 Hatch rare, valuable pets that offer INSANE Snowbux multipliers!

⚠️ Early release, more content coming soon! ⚠️
❤️ Thanks for playing!

Inspired by Grass Incremental
